_comment: Wavelength spectrums. One authored pair of opposites per entry.
Authoring rule: the two ends must be a genuine continuum, not two
categories. 'Cold / Hot' works because every point between them means
something; 'Cat / Dog' does not, and a clue for 63% of the way to Dog is
unplayable. If you cannot describe the 30% mark, the pair is wrong.
Second rule: both ends need to be things people rank differently. A
spectrum everyone agrees on has no game in it — the psychic says one word
and every guess lands in the same place.
The target is generated per round (0-100) and is server-only until the
reveal. The spectrum ITSELF is public — everyone needs to see the scale
they are guessing on. Only the target and the psychic's identity are held.
